hero.title: Just steps from the sea
hero.subtitle: Our little Los Roques
hero.description: A bright apartment just 50 metres from the Mediterranean. Perfect for holidays, getaways and working remotely by the sea.
hero.card1Text: Cross the promenade and you're on the beach. A bright apartment with a Mediterranean breeze.
hero.card2Text: Up to 18% cheaper than Airbnb. No fees, direct support via WhatsApp.
hero.card3Text: Ideal for working remotely by the sea. Smart TV, AC, dishwasher and a fully equipped kitchen.

directBooking.title: Why book here instead of Airbnb?
directBooking.perk1: Up to 18% cheaper than Airbnb (no fees)
directBooking.perk2: Direct support from the host via WhatsApp
directBooking.perk3: Flexible check-in at no extra cost

location.label: Location
location.title: El Campello, the promenade and the Mediterranean
location.description: Just steps from the sea is located in El Campello, one of the most pleasant coastal areas of Alicante, ideal for enjoying the Mediterranean Sea, the seafront promenade, restaurants, the beach and peaceful stays by the water.
location.point4: Ideal for holidays, getaways or remote work
